rationale: An IE filter argument is a `name = value` PAIR, and `parenthesized_value` allowed exactly one value, so the whole argument list was an ERROR. Measured A/B over 533 corpus files in 13 repositories: 61 error files -> 24, 37 fixed, 0 regressed, 0 collateral, grails-core 20.94% -> 1.57%. The first attempt (adding `=` to `arguments`' separators) was provably inert and is recorded in the review so it is not written twice. This file also carries an `@supports` block, because that class was a second omission the corpus rotation exposed — 16 scopes published, 0 rules attributed.
_targetSpelling: CSS-D15: a target that names a declaration THIS file publishes is spelled `<file-scope>::<name>`, where the scope is the file's project-relative path without its extension. The bare spelling stays for a target this file does not declare (a cross-file or external reference) and for `imports`, whose target is another file's module name.
